title: Story premise ENT024: The Giant Tiny Letter
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (cooperation). Hook: The letter is bigger than the delivery team. Takeaway/theme: Changing the object’s arrangement can beat adding more effort.
description: A group of tiny postal workers must deliver an envelope too wide for their cart, and pushing from different corners only spins it. One worker turns the envelope into a shallow tent around the cart, the others hold the folds, and they roll it safely to a toy mailbox.
